parameters.content:
## Spam gate columns - all 17 projects

Run `Spam columns - all projects` then this upsert node. Disconnected from everything else, like the other nodes here.

**Writes four columns:**
- `category_value_spam_marketing` = `spam`
- `category_value_duplicate_contact` = `duplicate_contact`
- `spam_confidence_threshold` = `0.97`
- `spam_model_id` = `gpt-5.4-nano`

Verified against live Zendesk 2026-08-27: every instance's category tagger has exactly one `Spam` (`spam`) and one `Duplicate contact` (`duplicate_contact`) option. No "Spam & Marketing" option exists anywhere.

`gpt-5.4-nano` chosen over `gpt-4.1-nano`, which the OpenAI API reports as shutting down 2026-10-23. Model list is org-wide, so one value works for every brand.

**Does NOT write `spam_check_enabled`.** That is the only remaining switch - nothing fires until you set it to true per brand.
